items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: When Mussolini’s brown shirts came to Mount Morris, he called ahead and found “Giovinezza” which was the theme song from Mussolini’s youth

ctx.x: Was your father, I’m not sure how to put this, was he living out a way of life that he wished he had had as a professional musician?

Could be. It’s very possible. Because you know he never had a childhood and he made sure that we had a real childhood and really had a family unit, which, you know, he was in an orphanage for a while so he made sure that we were in a good family unit and he told me that when he had three sons, you know that was a big deal having three sons, originally, because he did all kinds of carpentry and odd jobs. He figured he could have his own construction company with three boys, three sons, you could really do well.…

job. No one thought you could make a living doing that. But he made sure that we had that foundation. Of course then when we went off on our own and started playing without the family band, you know, we were making money and gigging so I think he was kind of pleased about that. And I’m sure he would have loved to have been a professional out in the real world, out in the world, but he had so many bands in the area. He had marching bands, he had concert bands, dance bands, you name it. So he had bands for every…
